title: Modern CSS & Layout
description: A complete 16-lesson CSS track combining web.dev's modern standards with W3Schools' interactive sandboxes, from the cascade, custom properties, Flexbox, and Grid/Subgrid to :has(), animations, and CSS nesting.
outcomes: Master CSS selectors, specificity, inheritance, and @layer cascade control
Use modern color spaces, fluid units, custom properties, and crisp typography
Build responsive layouts with Flexbox, CSS Grid, Subgrid, and @container queries
Style interactive states with :has(), logical properties, transitions, and @keyframes
Ship a responsive dashboard layout combining Grid and Flexbox
